subject: PO field validation, invoice cadence options, and discount trigger criteria
messages:
From: Elaine Brooks <elaine.brooks@greenpeak.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenpeak.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements + invoice cadence for discount eligibility

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at GreenPeak is excited about Redwood’s latency and cost features. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we send a blanket PO so we can qualify for the volume discount band you showed. Can you confirm the following?

1) Which PO header fields do you require for a valid invoice (PO number, ship-to, bill-to, BU code, cost center)?
2) Do you accept split invoices under a single PO (we prefer monthly invoice slices vs one monthly invoice)?
3) Net terms: we typically request Net45 for software vendors. Is a Net45 cadence acceptable for discount qualification, or do you require Net30/Net60?
4) Discount triggers: can you confirm the exact thresholds (commit $ or ARR) and whether the PO must reference the tier explicitly?

We can attach our standard PO template if that helps — I’ve cc’d procurement.

Best,
Elaine Brooks
Director, Procurement
GreenPeak Labs

Attachments: GreenPeak_PO_Template.pdf (stated)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Brooks <elaine.brooks@greenpeak.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence for discount eligibility

Hi Elaine — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Below are the requirements and options we can support; copying Vanessa (sales ops) and Priyom (revenue ops) to confirm edge cases.

Short answers up front:
- Required PO header fields: PO number, bill-to name + address, bill-to contact email, Redwood account number (we provide), and billing entity. Optional but strongly recommended: BU code / cost center.
- Invoice cadence: we support monthly or weekly invoice slices against a single PO. We can also do consolidated monthly invoice if you prefer a single statement.
- Net terms: Standard is Net30. Net45 can be supported for enterprise customers with a signed commitment (deal-level approval). Net60 requires finance sign-off and is uncommon for discount bands.
- Discount triggers: discounts are applied based on committed ARR tiers. The PO should reference the Redwood quote ID or deal_id (please put DEAL ID in PO header) to automatically qualify. If the PO is for a multi-quarter/annual commitment, list total committed spend and term length.

Details / examples:
- Required PO fields (exact strings we match automatically):
  * PO Number
  * Bill-To: <legal entity name>
  * Bill-To Address
  * Bill-To Contact Email
  * Redwood Account #: RW-<account-number> (we'll provide when you accept SOW)
  * Deal/Quote ID: e.g., GP-8472

- Invoice slicing: Example A: single PO, monthly invoices labeled PO-1234-M01 / PO-1234-M02. Example B: consolidated monthly statement referencing PO-1234 for all lines. Both are fine — for automated crediting to the commitment, ensure each invoice references the PO number and deal_id in the invoice header.

- Net terms and discount logic:
  * Net30: default and qualifies automatically for listed discounts.
  * Net45: requires procurement + finance approval on the contract. If approved, discount eligibility is unchanged (we'll apply the agreed tier) — approval typically takes 3–5 business days.
  * Net60: needs legal & finance approval and may delay onboarding/billing until a prepay or partial prepayment is agreed.

Attachments I’m including: Redwood_PO_Spec_v1.pdf (sample PO header format) and a short checklist for invoice metadata. If GreenPeak can send your PO template (you mentioned that), Priyom will take a look and confirm mapping.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call to finalize mapping so your AR team can get automated reconciliation. Proposed times tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT or Monday 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Spec_v1.pdf (attached)

Hi Logan,

Thanks — attaching our standard PO template and the draft SOW for the pilot. We prefer monthly invoice slices (easier for our GL) and are open to Net45 if that doesn’t change the discount bands. For GreenPeak to proceed we need confirmation on two final items:

- Can Redwood accept our PO numbering scheme (GP-PO-2027-345) rather than RW's PO number format? Will that still map to discounts automatically?
- Is an explicit discount line required on the invoice or will Redwood apply the discount on receipt based on the referenced deal_id?

If both are OK, procurement will issue the blanket PO next week.

Procurement Team
GreenPeak Labs

Attachments: GreenPeak_PO_Template.pdf, SOW-GP-2027-04.docx

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Elaine Brooks <elaine.brooks@greenpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence for discount eligibility

Hi — quick confirmations:

1) GP PO numbering (GP-PO-2027-345) is fine. As long as the PO number is present in the invoice header and the deal_id (GP-8472) is referenced, our ingestion logic will map invoices to the commitment. No need to change your numbering scheme.

2) Discount line: not required on the invoice. Redwood will apply the agreed discount on our side when the invoice is matched to the deal_id and the committed threshold is met. That said, if you include the discount line it helps your AP reconciliation.

Action items:
- Priyom will validate the attached PO template and confirm field mappings by EOD tomorrow. (Priyom: please confirm the expected Redwood account number format and whether we need an invoice header JSON for automated ingestion.)
- Vanessa: if procurement issues the blanket PO next week, please create the billing instruction block in the quote and flag for finance approval for Net45.

If you'd like, we can lock the PO mapping with a short joint runbook so your AP team knows the invoice naming convention (we can share a one-page mapping doc).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

—Logan
